run_teams_list: run the teams CLI command to list teams that the current user belongs to
run_teams_available: run the teams CLI command to list teams that are available to join
run_teams_assign_key: run the teams CLI command to assign the current API key to a specified team
build_teams_table: build a formatted rich table displaying team alias, team ID, models, max budget, and role for each team
review_teams_group: review the teams click group and its subcommands for listing, available, and assigning keys
